name: scene-vaati
title: Vaati
description: The bowl fills: seen from above, fresh pasta (ravioli, tortellini, gnocchi or farfalle) flies in from the edges along spinning arcs and settles, nudging the pieces already there; sauce is poured and spreads in a swirl, grated cheese falls and catches, basil lands, and the bowl rests. Quiet is a hairline still; warm is ink and wash; playful is flat poster colour with a bold outline, and a click tosses the pasta so it lands again. The progress attribute fills the bowl exactly that much, and sg-scene-settled says once that the meal is made.

budget.reason: four pasta shapes, and every drawing in three hands (hairline, ink and wash, flat poster), plus the pour, the toss and the settle signal
